comment: The bank holds 240 values. The rnd button and its input are in the code and on the panel but appear nowhere in the maker's manual, which documents only clock, run, reset, start, filter and length. The panel letters the three large knobs with a left bracket, a dot and a right bracket rather than with words; the maker's tooltips call them Start index, Filter and Length, and the manual calls the third one Sequence length. The 240-square and 96-square value displays are a single custom widget with no ParamWidget per square, so the squares carry no parameter positions and cannot be reached for help even though they can be dragged, clicked and muted. Every output is silenced while run is off, the cv output included, so a patch that goes quiet has usually had its run toggled.
